svg.aria-label: loadout: a survival kit of agent skills for Claude Code and Codex
svg.title: loadout
svg.desc: A survival-horror attaché case. LOADOUT is stenciled in blood on a stitched leather lid beside a biohazard plate and a heart monitor reading FINE; inside lie eleven typed case files, one per skill, clipped and tabbed in blood, gold and rust by kit.
svg.text: SURVIVAL KIT FOR CLAUDE CODE + CODEX
